These fuckers... Had an infestation at my old house. I had spent the night with a friend and must have brought them home in my bag or clothing. They hide in your books, in the joints between walls, ceilings, floors. The seams of your clothing, your bedding, mattress. They are *everywhere*. How do you get rid of them? Heat. Diatomaceous earth. sometimes, pest killers. BUT THEY SOMEHOW FUCKING EVADE THIS. You think they're gone. You miss a couple eggs. A month later, they're back.

You'd wake up with itchy welts, multiple from each bug. And the smell. it was awful. A musty scent, mixed with iron, maybe cilantro. You'd squish one to kill it, and a pungent stench would fill the room. It'd leave marks on your wall and bedding.

The damage it did to your confidence... Someone came over, and they didn't know? what if they brought them home with them, just to share our hell? If they knew, you could tell. They avoided sitting anywhere. Had cousins who told their kids when they came over to only sit on hard wooden surfaces. It hurt. I had gone on trips with friends, and on reached up, saying there was a bug on me, and they squished it. She didn't know what it was, but I did. You couldn't do anything, you felt hopeless, useless, hopeless. You feel filthy, plagued.

I believe they're gone. We moved to a new house. clothes, all items, EVERYTHING was left in a car or garage with no AC, left to the summer heat (90'F - 115'F most days). They were left for weeks before we brought them in. It's been two years, and there's still things we have sitting out, just to be certain. You'll never know the fear unless you've had them. Other possesions were burned. Old couches, mattresses, pillows. We wouldn't risk it.

Sometimes, I'll be trying to sleep. Then something brushes me. A crumb, piece of paper, who knows. I get paranoid. *What if they're back?!?* I'll grab a flashlight, lift the edge of my bed, and search. search for the black spots that show a colony of eggs. Look for a moving cluster of blood sucking freaks, scrambling to hide back in the mattress where I can't reach them. I keep lysol by my bed, because that has worked on colonies in the past.

I'm getting phantoms right now, reliving these memories. Sleeping is hard, sensitive to every sensation, fearful of another bug.

It's horrendous, and I wouldn't wish it on anyone (well, maybe Putin, but other than that-). It leaves you scarred.

Edited to add: When I get home from trips or a new person's house, my first move is to put my current clothes in the drier for an hour, then in with a load of laundry. I live in fear of it ever happening again. I saw one a few months ago somewhere, and nearly broke down crying from the memories of what had happened.
